name: Korea Sobaeksu Trading Company

attribution.legal_posture: Current OFAC exact-ID component-table data confirms the administrative-list entry and adds only the bounded structured context stated here. The subject is a DPRK trading/front company tied to overseas IT-worker movement; this is an OFAC administrative sanctions designation with no criminal charge or conviction on record.

caveats: Administrative sanctions state an administrative status; criminal charges and convictions require separate proceedings.
Sanctions-list address context is historical location context; present physical location, current operations, ownership, employment, or control require current evidence.
SDN.CSV, ADD.CSV, and ALT.CSV are component tables of one current OFAC dataset and count as one source family.
Street and postal addresses, birth data, passports, government and company identifiers, email addresses, financial selectors, and sanctions boilerplate are excluded.
The administrative rows provide city-entry context; current control, ownership, and operations at either city remain unresolved.
Treasury's headline paragraph contains a one-off 'Sobaesku' misspelling; reject it as a canonical alias unless another official record independently uses it.
